payload.title: The Anchors Hold
paragraphs: The Demon Lord falls under the Somnolith he tried to call down. It doesn't come.
The Anchors hold. Their chains still hum in the cold, and the arches still stand over the snow. The Somnolith stays in the sky, as close as it has ever been and no closer.
Nobody can say for how long. Keep it asleep, cut the lines, or let it come: that question is yours now, and it isn't answered today.
Which leaves the caravan. It was the Choir's, white from axle to awning, and you stole it on tithe day. It has been a home, a battlefield and a rumour on every road since.
Now you decide what it becomes.
